name: jane-ai-backend
description: Jane AI - Multilingual AI Course Voice Counseling Backend

scripts.build: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt || pip install --break-system-packages -r requirements.txt || pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.start: .venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT || python3 -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT || uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT
